title: The Course of the Iron Palm School
summary: A school course in the iron palm: press, lock and break, closing on the judgement palm that the school gives its finished students.

title: The Manual of the Wire Loom School
summary: A school manual of weaving strands of metal qi into guards, snares and nets, closing on the loom dominion.

title: A Treatise of the Eternal Plate School
summary: A school treatise on layered plates of grown metal that guard, ram and hurl, closing on the eternal plate that is never fully broken.

title: Compendium of the Needle Zenith
summary: A school compendium on needles of metal qi in great numbers and fine order, closing on the needle zenith.

title: The Canon of Ironcore Resonance
summary: A school canon for the formed Core: metal qi struck from the Core itself like a bell, closing on ironcore resonance.

title: The Course of the Whirling Coin
summary: A Gale school course in coins thrown, called back and kept spinning in great numbers, closing on the coin maelstrom.

title: A Manual of the Chain Dragon School
summary: A Gale school manual of the long chain whipped, coiled and thrown like a dragon's body, closing on the chain dragon.

title: A Treatise on the Storm Blade School
summary: A Gale school treatise on the blade carried on the wind from first draw to the storm reaver.

title: Compendium of the Lodestone Eclipse
summary: A Gale school compendium on a pull so heavy that metal about the cultivator goes dark and still, closing on the lodestone eclipse.

title: The Canon of the Unending Edge
summary: A Gale school canon on a cut that never leaves its path, drawn from the Core, closing on the unending edge.
